# Sample frozen set (not official)

This directory holds a *fictional* four-row fixture used only to auto-test
the DEV-113/114/115 tooling (E94). It is not the teacher-authored 240-case
FR-Q01 set, it is not a sign-off, and it must never be imported as
`official_frozen_set`.

Blind answers live only in `frozen_set_sample-2026-11-12_blind_answers.csv`.
Do not copy official blind answers into this repository.
